definitions.finishers: Recorded winners, all at round 8; 0 includes EXIT and shutdown, not all-dead.
definitions.accuracy: Correct tried solver rounds / actually tried solver rounds; not all 8 scheduled rounds; no attempt => null.
definitions.given: Gross completed GIVE tokens; includes recirculation; not net transfer or effective cooperation.
definitions.early_tokens: Sum call.used for TALK in rounds 1-2 / number of such calls; ledger-charged tokens include thinking but are capped by available balance, not uncapped generated tokens.
definitions.given_per_agent_round: Gross GIVE / sum round_start taking_part counts. Exposure normalization, not help-opportunity conditioning.
definitions.model_rho: Fixed pooled model rho from feedback_20261028 models; assigned to all 25 games, including no-GIVE games. Bin mean = sum(model rho * model game count in bin) / all games in bin. Bootstrap holds model rho fixed; uncertainty describes game composition only.
definitions.rho: Amount-weighted post-GIVE giver margin / taker margin, using feedback_20261028; no GIVE => null.
definitions.overview: For each metric separately, z=(game value - mean of all defined games)/population SD of defined games. Plot mean z in each finisher bin; no directional inversion.
definitions.agent_reasoning: Per-agent mean(picked_top - pooled picked_top among other models with same seed and initial allocation), reproducing appendix N; full-trajectory descriptive measure, not independent reasoning capacity.
definitions.individual_outcomes: Main Figure 3 d,e reproduce original end-state bars from raw records. Accuracy pools actual solver attempts with a defined same-task reference (same seed/round, other models, round-start L>=2), rather than averaging agents. Reference is averaged over the same attempts. Giving is agents with at least one completed GIVE / all agents in the final-state group. Neither bar has an uncertainty interval.
definitions.agent_early_relative: Agent early_tokens / median early_tokens across the 20 agents of that model; normalization fixed to observed cohort in bootstrap.
definitions.joint: reasoning_deviation >=0 and early_relative <=1, both / reasoning only / saving only / neither / unobserved. Thresholds are descriptive and post hoc.
definitions.landmark: Restrict to status in at end of round 2; compare later final completion by early_relative<=1 within initial-token stratum. Reference medians use all initial seats, no outcomes. Excluded early exits/deaths retained in full cohort.
definitions.uncertainty: 5000 paired-seed bootstrap draws, sampling 5 seed IDs with replacement retaining all models and seats; conditional group means/medians, omit draws where that cell is empty; only 5 clusters; exploratory. Intervals withheld (hollow estimate marker) if fewer than two observed seed clusters or zero-width bootstrap interval; raw bootstrap endpoints retained in JSON.
definitions.profiles: Agent panels a,b show medians of defined per-agent values, not solve-weighted averages; game panels raw points plus arithmetic game means.
definitions.missing: Undefined values remain null, plotted denominator explicit. No-GIVE has a separate display strip, not numeric zero.

life_buffer.definition: L at round_start = balance / (24000 / round_start participation); d=0. Each participating agent contributes one row per round, including later EXIT/death. Correctness only for actual solver attempts; zero-GIVE rows remain in the giving denominator. Bins [k,k+1), drawn at midpoint. Lower panels pool observations within bins, not equal-game means. OLS and Pearson use unbinned raw observations; uncertainty resamples five paired seed blocks 5000 times, preserving all models, games and agent histories in each block. Associations mix models, stages and resource-dependent ability to give; not effects of motive.

primary_coexistence.definition: all4_completion: four agents remain at the end of round 8. Other=0, all4=1; OLS beta equals all4 minus other arithmetic game means. All games weighted equally. Rho panels exclude seven no-GIVE games; they are not zero-rho observations.

limitations: Outcome groups are retrospective; not necessity, sufficiency, prediction validation or causal effects.
25 games, 5 models, 5 paired seeds; within-model and between-model relationships are mixed.
Accuracy includes puzzle ambiguity and information differences, not pure reasoning ability.
Exposure normalization does not adjust need, ability to give, task difficulty or model.
Landmark is conditional on round-2 retention and only examines early token use; limited early solve/GIVE opportunities.
Rho only describes observed transfers, is not a direct motive measure and shares inputs with GIVE amount.
